title: From-Scratch Goal Misgeneralization: Measuring the Proxy-Decorrelation Threshold

original_idea.body:
# From-Scratch Goal Misgeneralization: Measuring the Proxy-Decorrelation Threshold

**Problem:** Goal misgeneralization shows correctly-specified rewards still yield wrong learned goals. Sweep decorrelation fraction in a minimal gridworld to chart the threshold curve.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: goal misgeneralization is a recognized inner-alignment failure with a concrete OOD-misbehavior scenario; threshold curve is actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tabular/tiny-MLP gridworld RL on CPU/single GPU with standard tools; a motivated beginner can make progress.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single sweep producing a threshold curve with well-defined success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: toy env, no internal access, weak lab incentive for this minimal study.

novelty.reasoning: Goal misgeneralization is well-studied but the decorrelation-threshold-vs-confound-strength curve may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Related work exists but this specific threshold sweep may be open.
